source.severity_rule: Low: index < 100/3; Medium: 100/3 <= index < 200/3; High: index >= 200/3. Project-defined equal-third severity bins, not sensor ground-truth labels.
source.warning: Public publisher data, not independently verified Bengaluru sensor records. This is not the missing six-block project archive.

split.method: chronological by target date: 70% train, 15% validation, 15% test

forecast.notice: Daily publisher data only. The separate original block archive is now restored. Daily Low/Medium/High are project-defined bins of the source index, not verified sensor labels.

vehicles.scope: Six public Chinese traffic scenes; 15 seconds each. Not a Bengaluru camera-site calibration or all-weather guarantee.
vehicles.classes: All vehicles combined; per-class accuracy not claimed because source/COCO taxonomies differ.

acceptance.scope: Frame-count and line-crossing estimates only; not distinct clip totals.

distinct_count_validation.notice: Tracker IDs can fragment and count a vehicle again. Do not present track totals as verified distinct vehicles.

coverage.coverage: Entire supported Bengaluru region with 2 km boundary buffer
coverage.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; extract by Geofabrik
coverage.notice: Real mapped road geometry, not live traffic. Unmapped roads and access restrictions can limit routing.

routing.source: Real Geofabrik/OpenStreetMap extract; all routes computed locally.

original_archive.notice: Original supplied project archive. Its six block volumes are rounded fixed shares of the public daily source; these are derived time blocks, not six independently measured CCTV/sensor intervals. Labels are unverified.

metrics.task: Next-block severity on the restored project archive. Classifier and feature complexity selected using validation only; simple candidates retain the original input definition.

split.method: chronological target dates: 70% training / 15% validation / 15% test

transfer_validation.reason: Transfer beat the majority baseline on held-out roads.

simplicity_selection.method: One paired date-clustered validation standard error; 400 resamples, seed 42.

experiment.preprocessing: Cycle scales fitted on complete training road-days. Training profiles see earlier labels only. Cross-date projections are absent.

metrics.caveat: Historical re-evaluation: this source/test era was already examined in the project and earlier experiments. The source derives six blocks from daily values. Scores do not validate six independently measured traffic intervals or current Bengaluru forecasts.

checks.check: macro-F1 beats the best baseline (historical_profile) by at least 0.02
accuracy is at least the majority-class baseline
every class with at least 5 test records is predicted correctly at least once

tracking_upgrade.scope: Four newly acquired official test scenes; previous test scenes excluded. Chinese road footage, not Bengaluru site validation.
tracking_upgrade.metric_scope: Common every-second-source-frame metric frames. Visible detections use >=0.35 confidence independently of track confirmation. Identity metrics use confirmed association trajectories.
tracking_upgrade.notice: Confirmed track IDs remain estimates of distinct vehicles; identity switches and occlusion can still cause errors.
tracking_upgrade.clip_only_scope: Confirmed uploaded-clip tracks only. The full flow check failed; stream line counting retains the previous policy.

location.confidence: Approximate public Banaswadi junction reference, not surveyed.

public_camera.affiliation: Independent public webcam; not a Bengaluru Traffic Police feed.
public_camera.notice: Low-refresh public imagery. Visible-frame estimates require review; reliable distinct counts, flow and queues are not established.

measurement.measurement_notice: Low-refresh imagery supports visible-frame estimates; reliable distinct counts, line flow and queues need a higher frame rate.
